title: After Colts’ sluggish road showing, Pittsburgh remains franchise ‘House of Horrors’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: After Colts’ sluggish road showing, Pittsburgh remains franchise ‘House of Horrors’
sources.description: The Indianapolis Colts hadn’t won in Pittsburgh since 2008, and after another sluggish road showing in ‘The Steel City on Sunday, that rather surprising franchise losing streak only continued—as the Horseshoe fell 34-22 as their late comeback attempts fell short. Offensively, the Steelers once again bottled up Colts star running back Jonathan Taylor and the […]
